items_all.summary: The heads of the biggest AI labs — Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Nvidia — went to Washington and signed the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' promising to develop their own models safely. Trump tells federal agencies to use the term 'Super Intelligence ' instead of artificial intelligence
items_all.summary: President Donald Trump issued an executive order directing all federal agencies to stop using the term 'artificial intelligence' and instead call it 'Super Intelligence.' The president said that the new term will solve AI's branding issue and that it 'more appropriately captures the promise, potential, and rapidly advancing capabilities of these technologies.'

items_all.title: The price of AI is crashing faster than the rate of Moore's Law, report suggests
items_all.summary: The price of AI "intelligence," has fallen dramatically in recent years, faster than any other transformational technology in history according to some estimates. This raises serious questions about the need to retain access to frontier capabilities, when they show up elsewhere so swiftly.

items_all.title: The state of agentic AI in chip design tools in 2026
items_all.summary: Cadence, Synopsys, and Siemens all offer agentic AI for chip design, largely built on Nvidia's stack, with varying claims of autonomy.

items_all.title: The Ethernet spec was first drafted on this day in 1980
items_all.summary: On this day in 1980, version 1.0 of the Ethernet specification was published by Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC), Intel, and Xerox.

items_all.title: Developer trains a small AI on a single RTX 3080 Ti gaming GPU to 'play' Pokémon Red
items_all.summary: A developer trained a JEPA world model, based on LeWorldModel research co-authored by Yann LeCun, on an RTX 3080 Ti to play Pokémon Red.

items_all.title: Nuvacore reveals unconventional Core First CPU IP design strategy
items_all.summary: NuvaCore says it is developing its new WarpCore CPU IP without first choosing the ISA it will implement. This unusual development strategy is meant to offer the company maximum technology and business flexibility.

items_all.title: ‘This is how AI should be used’ — OpenAI head of hardware breaks down the AI-assisted design of its Jalapeño ASIC
items_all.summary: OpenAI says AI-assisted Jalapeño chip design "established a new baseline" for the industry, and there is already a lot of interest from others to learn how the company pulled it off.

items_all.title: Pentagon gets pwned as breach exposes sensitive data on nearly three million military and civilian personnel
items_all.summary: Hackers have breached the U.S. Department of Defense's information systems. The Pentagon says that it has already secured the source of the leak, but the records of millions of DoD personnel are now in the wild.

items_all.title: Former EVGA employee recounts company’s degrading relationship with Nvidia before 2022 blow-up
items_all.summary: In a personal blog, former EVGA product manager Brendon Ray Hedrick shared how the first Nvidia Founders Edition GPUs alarmed the company and how pricing pressure and risky forward-looking tech ultimately led to the end of the two companies' storied partnership.

items_all.title: AMD acquires AI legend Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
items_all.summary: AMD has agreed agreed to buy generative AI world model developer World Labs for $8.2 billion in stock. Legendary CEO and co-founder Fei-Fei Li will join the company as an executive vice president and chief scientist.
